event.title: Interfaze released Ask Box
event.summary: Interfaze introduced Ask Box: a chrome extension you can install and make all your @Box files into your company brain There's no setup, just install, connect your Box account and you're good to go Works with all the security feature of Box with permissions and authorizations.
